mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_table (table_code, table_name, pk_strategy, description, is_enabled, business_code, database_name) VALUES (#{tableCode}, #{tableName}, #{pkStrategy}, #{description}, #{isEnabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{businessCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{databaseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_table SET table_name = #{tableName}, pk_strategy = #{pkStrategy}, description = #{description}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, business_code = #{businessCode}, database_name = #{databaseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM metadata_table WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM metadata_table WHERE table_code = #{tableCode}
AND business_code = #{businessCode}

choose.when:
SELECT * FROM metadata_table
AND table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
AND business_code = #{businessCode}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
choose.otherwise:
SELECT t.* FROM metadata_table t INNER JOIN metadata_business_system bs ON t.business_code = bs.business_code LEFT JOIN metadata_physical_database pdb ON ( NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), ''))), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(pdb.catalog_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), '')))) )
bs.is_enabled = 1 AND t.is_enabled = 1 AND (pdb.id IS NULL OR pdb.is_enabled = 1)
AND t.table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
AND t.business_code = #{businessCode}
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_table WHERE table_code = #{tableCode}

choose.otherwise:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_table t INNER JOIN metadata_business_system bs ON t.business_code = bs.business_code LEFT JOIN metadata_physical_database pdb ON ( NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), ''))), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(pdb.catalog_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), '')))) )
bs.is_enabled = 1 AND t.is_enabled = 1 AND (pdb.id IS NULL OR pdb.is_enabled = 1)
AND t.table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
AND t.business_code = #{businessCode}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_table WHERE database_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(database_name) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(database_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{databaseName}))
SELECT * FROM metadata_table WHERE database_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(database_name) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(database_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{databaseName})) ORDER BY id ASC
